messages.speaker: Aisha Khan
messages.content: Partners complain they miss events when their endpoint is down for more than an hour.

messages.speaker: Tomas Silva
messages.content: With 3 retries over about 12 minutes we give up too early.

messages.speaker: Elena Petrova
messages.content: Increase to 5 retries with backoff of 30s, 2m, 10m, 30m, 2h.

messages.speaker: Aisha Khan
messages.content: Decision: 5 retries. TKT-114 covers the change and the spec update for DOC-006.
